name: W Bangkok
insider_take: W Bangkok pulses with electric energy in the heart of Sathorn district, where cutting-edge design meets Thailand's vibrant capital city.
whats_special: This ultra-modern tower features Asia's largest hotel infinity pool on the 76th floor, offering breathtaking 360-degree views of Bangkok's glittering skyline. The hotel's signature WOOBAR transforms into the city's highest rooftop lounge, while the property sits directly above BTS Chong Nonsi station for seamless city exploration.
pro_tip: Book sunset cocktails at WOOBAR during weekdays to avoid crowds and secure the best Instagram shots with the Chao Phraya River bend as your backdrop.
dont_miss: The hotel's exclusive access to Sathorn's diplomatic quarter puts you steps from embassies and upscale dining, while the iconic Wat Pho temple and Grand Palace are just a quick BTS ride away. The in-house AWAY Spa offers traditional Thai treatments with a contemporary twist in a serene 31st-floor sanctuary.
pros: Prime location in Sathorn district with easy BTS access
Iconic modern design with panoramic city skyline views
Vibrant rooftop bars and award-winning dining venues
Contemporary luxury rooms with cutting-edge technology
cons: Modern lifestyle hotel may not suit traditional luxury preferences
